"''Well, we need stuff. Arkie's up the beach. He'll be open.''"
"''I was planning to go the other way.''"
"''Mmm, Arkie has the new flavors.|Cassian Andor and Windi|}} '''Windi''' was a curly-[[hair]]ed [[human]] [[Gender|woman]] who spent [[time]] with [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], a man she knew as "Keef Girgo," in a [[Niamos hotel|hotel]] suite on the [[Planet|world]] [[Niamos]] in [[5 BBY]]. After the pair ran out of [[Peezo]]s and [[Revnog]], she asked him to pick up more from [[Arkie's]] while he was on a walk, but Andor was arrested by the [[Galactic Empire]] while out and did not return to her. ==Biography== {{Quote|Don't forget the Peezos.''"
"''We ran out of Peezos?''"
"''Peezos and Revnog.|Windi and Andor|}} [[File:Windi-Andor.png|thumb|right|300px|Windi stayed with "Keef Girgo" on Niamos.]] Windi was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who spent [[time]] with the human male [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], who was in hiding under the alias "Keef Girgo," in a large airy [[Niamos hotel|hotel]] suite on the [[planet]]{{Databank|niamos|Niamos}} [[Niamos]] in [[5 BBY]].{{AndorDate|107}} After awakening in the [[clothing]]-strewn suite's bed and hearing the room's [[shower]] running, she called out for "Keef" and asked what he was doing. Andor, who was in fact checking a container of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] and other items that he had hidden above the shower, called out to her that he was washing up and would be out shortly to go for a walk. Windi then asked that he pick up some items from [[Arkie's]], pointing out that [[Arkie]] had the new flavors when Andor replied that he had planned on walking in the other direction. She also reminded him to get more [[Peezo]]s and [[Color|green]] [[revnog]], as they had run out. Andor left but never returned from the walk, as he was arrested by the [[Galactic Empire]] and taken offworld for [[Prisoner|imprisonment]] on{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} the [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]].{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} After Andor later [[Narkina 5 prison escape|escaped]] from [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|prison]], he returned to the suite to collect his container, but Windi was no longer staying there.{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|The greenie green one. The greenie Revnog. You liked it, too.|Windi, talking to Andor|}} Windi was a slender, dark-skinned human woman with thick curly brown [[hair]]. She enjoyed green revnog. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Working with Diego Luna was an absolute joy. I adored chatting and running lines together in between takes.|Katrina Nare|{{Instagram|username=katrinanare|url=p/Cj-bj-Qo5U1|name=[[Katrina Nare]]|date=2022-10-21|archivedate=2022-12-22|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/Sfjfq#selection-567.0-567.107}}}} Windi was portrayed by [[Katrina Nare]] in "[[Announcement]]," the seventh episode of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 1|first season]], which was released on [[October 19]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} Nare ran lines with Andor's actor [[Diego Luna]] between takes while filming the scene in [[2021]]. The character's name was not spoken in the episode but appeared in the credits and subtitles. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Windi}} *{{Andor|Announcement}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Windi |ja=ウィンディ（ニアモス） |ka=ვინდი |pl=Windi }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
